eligibility_note: Own panel estimation (FE, FE with interactions, IV-2SLS, GMM); exposure mobile subscriptions and internet users; 40 low and lower-middle income countries, an explicit low vs lower-middle comparison via a dummy; outcome poverty headcount (family 4).

results.correction: Direction negative overall; FE spec 3 is +0.005 and spec 5/10 are -0.008/-0.02, so FE is mixed in significance. Bolding lost, per-cell significance unreadable.
GMM MCS and IU coefficients match IV; minor differences exist only in MCS spec 4 SE (0.02 vs 0.01) and spec 3 Low dummy.

heterogeneity.quote: In 4 out of 10 specifications we have obtained positive and significant coefficients ... in remaining 6 equations the Lowy,c is returned as insignificant (p.10-11)
in only 3 out of 8 specifications reported in Table 4, net effects were feasible to calculate (p.12)
coefficients standing by all interaction terms in specification FE_I(1)-FE_I(8) are negative and statistically significant ... poverty trap effect (p.11)

income_group_note: Only a Low dummy in pooled regressions; no subsample estimates by income group. High and upper-middle not in sample.

risk_of_bias.confounding_reverse_causation: agree: country FE only and GDP per capita as sole instrument violates the exclusion restriction, with causal language used.
risk_of_bias.exposure_measurement: agree: standard ITU subscriptions and internet-user share, adequate proxies for exposure.
risk_of_bias.selection_of_countries_years: agree: countries chosen by data availability, excluding islands and conflict areas; poverty interpolated and observation counts vary 187-776 despite 'strongly balanced'.
risk_of_bias.outcome_measurement: too_harsh: the $5.50 headcount is a standard World Bank series; interpolation is a weakness but moderate is more fitting than serious (Table 2 mean 75.9 vs ~34% in 2019 is an oddity but not shown to be an error).
risk_of_bias.specification: agree: many ad hoc regressor subsets, mixed observation counts, no clear preferred model; Table 3 gives no SE type (Table 4-6 say robust).
risk_of_bias.selective_reporting: agree: net effects only where signs fit expectations, and text claims all interactions significant while bolding is unreadable.
risk_of_bias.why: Serious overall is right because causal claims rest on FE plus an invalid single instrument; the outcome domain alone would be moderate.

problems: none material. Record is consistent with the text. Minor: GMM Table 6 obs for spec 2 is 766 vs 776 in IV; Table 6 MCS spec 4 R2 0.16 vs 0.17 in Table 5.
